import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Create id for test
test["id"] = test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str)
test = test[["id", "before"]]

# Create id for train
train["id"] = train["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train["token_id"].astype(str)

# Hold-out validation split from training (10% hold-out)
# IMPORTANT: Split BEFORE building any frequency maps to avoid data leakage
np.random.RandomState(42).seed(42)
n_samples = len(train)
val_indices = np.random.RandomState(42).choice(
    n_samples, size=n_samples // 10, replace=False
)
val_mask = np.zeros(n_samples, dtype=bool)
val_mask[val_indices] = True

train_final = train[~val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
val_holdout = train[val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Final train shape: {train_final.shape}")
print(f"Validation hold-out shape: {val_holdout.shape}")

# Build class-aware lookup table: (before, class) -> most common after
print("Building class-aware lookup table...")
class_after_map = (
    train_final.groupby(["before", "class"])["after"]
    .apply(lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0])
    .to_dict()
)

# For each "before" text, find which classes it appears with
print("Building aggregate frequency map across ALL (before, after) pairs...")
# Count all (before, after) occurrences across ALL classes
before_after_counts = {}
for before, class_, after in zip(
    train_final["before"], train_final["class"], train_final["after"]
):
    if before not in before_after_counts:
        before_after_counts[before] = {}
    if after not in before_after_counts[before]:
        before_after_counts[before][after] = 0
    before_after_counts[before][after] += 1

# Build final prediction map using hybrid approach
print("Building hybrid prediction map (class-aware + aggregate fallback)...")
final_map = {}

# First, count class distribution per "before" text
before_class_counts = (
    train_final.groupby(["before", "class"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
)

for before_text, row in before_class_counts.iterrows():
    # Get classes for this before text
    classes_with_counts = [(col, val) for col, val in row.items() if val > 0]

    if len(classes_with_counts) == 0:
        # No classes found, use fallback
        final_map[before_text] = before_text
        continue

    # Check if this before text has a single dominant class (>50% of occurrences)
    total_count = sum(val for _, val in classes_with_counts)
    dominant_class = None
    for cls, count in classes_with_counts:
        if count / total_count > 0.5:
            dominant_class = cls
            break

    # Class-aware path: use most common (before, dominant_class) after
    if dominant_class and (before_text, dominant_class) in class_after_map:
        final_map[before_text] = class_after_map[(before_text, dominant_class)]
    else:
        # Fallback: use aggregate (before, after) frequency voting
        if before_text in before_after_counts:
            after_counts = before_after_counts[before_text]
            final_map[before_text] = max(after_counts, key=after_counts.get)
        else:
            final_map[before_text] = before_text

# Evaluate on validation hold-out set
print("Evaluating on hold-out validation set...")
val_predictions = []
val_correct = 0
val_total = 0

for idx, row in val_holdout.iterrows():
    pred = final_map.get(row["before"], row["before"])
    val_predictions.append(pred)
    val_total += 1
    if pred == row["after"]:
        val_correct += 1

val_accuracy = val_correct / val_total
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Create submission for test set
print("Creating submission for test set...")
submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["id"] = test["id"]
submission["after"] = test["before"].map(final_map).fillna(test["before"])

submission = submission[["id", "after"]]
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

print("\n=== Final Validation Metrics ===")
print(f"Total tokens: {val_total}")
print(f"Correct predictions: {val_correct}")
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"Sample predictions:\n{submission.head(10)}")
